pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark contiguous regions on the flank and neck display irregular, multi-polygonal geometries with smooth, diffused pixel gradients at the edges rather than sharp transitions. The relative spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, with larger, more elongated patches on the mid-flank and smaller, fragmented clusters transitioning toward the ventral and anterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected topological graph. Junction nodes are clearly visible, typically connecting three to four pathways. The pixel thickness of these corridors is non-uniform, narrowing between large adjacent patches and widening at the nodal intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette against the background, appearing as a dense and uniform linear ridge.
